title: Injective abelian sheaves on a site have trivial higher Cech cohomology
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site and $\mathcal I$ an injective object of $\textit{Ab}(\mathcal C)$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Then for every covering $\mathcal U=\{U_t\to U\}_{t\in T}$ of $\mathcal C$ the Cech cohomology [def-weil-pbc-site-cech-complex] satisfies $\check H^p(\mathcal U,\mathcal I)=0$ for all $p>0$ (and $\check H^0(\mathcal U,\mathcal I)=\mathcal I(U)$). (General-site version of [lem-weil-pbc-injective-sheaf-cech-acyclic], which is stated for the small etale site; its proof is the same: $\mathcal I$ is injective in $\textit{PAb}(\mathcal C)$ (Lemma 03F6, sheafification being an exact left adjoint of the inclusion), and $\check{\mathcal C}^\bullet(\mathcal U,\mathcal I)=\operatorname{Hom}_{\textit{PAb}}(\mathbf Z_{\mathcal U,\bullet},\mathcal I)$ with $\mathbf Z_{\mathcal U,\bullet}$ exact in positive degrees.)
